metadata.question: Does the surface water extent along the Lower Mississippi River (e.g., Arkansas City, Arkansas; Vicksburg, Mississippi; Natchez, Mississippi) increase in March 19, 2019 compared to March 19, 2017?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
   - Use Sentinel-1 GRD (COPERNICUS/S1_GRD), IW mode, VV and VH, both orbits. Target three locations: Arkansas City AR, Vicksburg MS, Natchez MS. ROI = union of 25 km buffers around each point.
   - For each target date (2017-03-19, 2019-03-19), search ±3 days; if empty, widen to ±10 then ±20 days.
2. Masking strategy.
   - SAR is cloud-insensitive; no cloud mask needed. Detect water by backscatter thresholds on log10(VV) and log10(VH): water if VV_dB < -17 and VH_dB < -23.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
   - Immediately check ImageCollection size; if 0 after fallbacks → C1.
   - Compute valid pixel count over ROI; if 0 → C2.
   - If any metric returns null/NaN → C3.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfoAsync(obj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((v) => resolve(v), (e) => reject(e));
  });
}

function roiLowerMississippi() {
  var arkansasCity = ee.Geometry.Point([-91.205, 33.609]);
  var vicksburg = ee.Geometry.Point([-90.877, 32.3526]);
  var natchez = ee.Geometry.Point([-91.4032, 31.5604]);
  var bufferKm = 25;
  var roi = arkansasCity.buffer(bufferKm * 1000)
    .union(vicksburg.buffer(bufferKm * 1000))
    .union(natchez.buffer(bufferKm * 1000));
  return roi;
}

function getS1Collection(roi, start, end) {
  return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD')
    .filterBounds(roi)
    .filterDate(start, end)
    .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW'))
    .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV'))
    .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VH'))
    .filter(ee.Filter.eq('resolution_meters', 10));
}

async function compositeForDate(roi, dateStr) {
  var base = ee.Date(dateStr);
  var windows = [3, 10, 20]; // days
  var usedWin = null;
  var count = 0;
  var col = null;

  for (var i = 0; i < windows.length; i++) {
    var w = windows[i];
    var start = base.advance(-w, 'day');
    var end = base.advance(w + 1, 'day'); // inclusive window end
    col = getS1Collection(roi, start, end);
    count = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (count > 0) { usedWin = w; break; }
  }
  if (!usedWin) {
    return {status: 'C1', message: `No S1 images near ${dateStr}.`};
  }
  var med = col.median().clip(roi).select(['VV', 'VH']);
  // Convert to dB with floor to avoid -Inf
  var vv_db = med.select('VV').max(1e-6).log10().multiply(10).rename('VV_dB');
  var vh_db = med.select('VH').max(1e-6).log10().multiply(10).rename('VH_dB');
  var img = vv_db.addBands(vh_db);

  // Valid pixel count
  var validCount = ee.Image(1).updateMask(img.mask().reduce('min')).reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: roi,
    scale: 1000,
    maxPixels: 1e9,
    tileScale: 2
  }).get('constant');

  var validCountVal = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(validCount));
  if (validCountVal === null || validCountVal === 0) {
    return {status: 'C2', message: `No valid pixels after processing for ${dateStr}.`, usedWin, count};
  }

  // Water mask: low backscatter in both VV and VH
  var waterMask = img.select('VV_dB').lt(-17).and(img.select('VH_dB').lt(-23));
  var waterArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(waterMask).rename('area');

  var waterAreaM2 = waterArea.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
    geometry: roi,
    scale: 1000,
    maxPixels: 1e9,
    tileScale: 2
  }).get('area');

  var waterAreaVal = await getInfoAsync(ee.Number(waterAreaM2));
  if (waterAreaVal === null || isNaN(waterAreaVal)) {
    return {status: 'C3', message: `Calculation failure (area null/NaN) for ${dateStr}.`, usedWin, count};
  }

  // Also report median backscatter (sanity)
  var vvMedDb = await getInfoAsync(img.select('VV_dB').reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.median(),
    geometry: roi,
    scale: 1000,
    maxPixels: 1e9,
    tileScale: 2
  }).get('VV_dB'));

  return {
    status: 'OK',
    usedWin,
    count,
    water_km2: waterAreaVal / 1e6,
    validPx: validCountVal,
    vvMedDb: vvMedDb
  };
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    const roi = roiLowerMississippi();

    const d2017 = await compositeForDate(roi, '2017-03-19');
    if (d2017.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(`2017: ${d2017.message}`);
      console.log('C1' === d2017.status ? 'C1' : (d2017.status === 'C2' ? 'C2' : 'C3'));
      return;
    }
    const d2019 = await compositeForDate(roi, '2019-03-19');
    if (d2019.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(`2019: ${d2019.message}`);
      console.log('C1' === d2019.status ? 'C1' : (d2019.status === 'C2' ? 'C2' : 'C3'));
      return;
    }

    console.log(`2017 S1 imgs: ${d2017.count} (±${d2017.usedWin} d), valid px: ${d2017.validPx}`);
    console.log(`2017 water area (km^2): ${d2017.water_km2.toFixed(2)}, VV_med_dB: ${d2017.vvMedDb !== null ? d2017.vvMedDb.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`);

    console.log(`2019 S1 imgs: ${d2019.count} (±${d2019.usedWin} d), valid px: ${d2019.validPx}`);
    console.log(`2019 water area (km^2): ${d2019.water_km2.toFixed(2)}, VV_med_dB: ${d2019.vvMedDb !== null ? d2019.vvMedDb.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`);

    const delta = d2019.water_km2 - d2017.water_km2;
    console.log(`Delta water (2019-2017) km^2: ${delta.toFixed(2)}`);

    if (!isFinite(delta)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    if (delta > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${String(err).slice(0, 200)}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
